rows.en:
(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Oh, \p.
What is it?

Griffith Park... Well, it's not bad...
Hmm...!?

Sorry, I've got a little work this weekend...
Ask me again if you get the chance.

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Oh, \p-chan.
What is it?

Um, I was wondering if you'd want to spend
the weekend with me at Griffith Park...
rows.notes: Female; answers 'What is it?', so the opening hai is 'Um' here, not 'Yes'. Male twin c04170.

rows.en:
(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl to stop off
somewhere on the way home...)

Hey, Sheryl. You wanna stop off somewhere
on the way home?

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to stop off
somewhere on the way home.)

Oh, Sheryl-san.
Would you like to stop off somewhere
on the way home?

(This weekend, maybe I'll invite Sheryl
to go shopping in Deep Akihabara...)

Deep Akihabara!? That sounds kind of fun!
...Oh!?

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to go shopping
in Deep Akihabara...)

Um, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping in Deep Akihabara with me this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl to a concert
at the Sky Gate.)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
a concert at the Sky Gate with me this weekend...
rows.notes: x4, male; also frd_yuu_114 (Akimizu). As c04182.

rows.en:
Hmm, well... Once in a while, it might be nice
to see someone else's concert...
...Oh!?

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to go see
a concert at the Sky Gate...)

Um, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
a concert at the Sky Gate with me this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl to go shopping at Folmo.)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping at Folmo with me this weekend...

I'm sorry...
I'm just not in the mood for that right now...
rows.notes: x8, Sheryl, both genders, frd_she_115/116 (low-mood refusal).

rows.en: I'm really sorry. I'll be going, then...
Ah, wait, Sheryl...
(Sheryl...)

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to go shopping
at Folmo.)

Um, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping at Folmo with me this weekend...
Ah, wait, Sheryl-san...
(Sheryl-san...)

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl to get something
to eat at Nyan-Nyan.)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to grab
a bite at Nyan-Nyan with me this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Sheryl-san to get something
to eat at Nyan-Nyan.)

Um, I was wondering if you'd want to grab
a bite at Nyan-Nyan with me this weekend...

(There's some EX-Gear maintenance stuff
I don't get, so I'm sure Hoshimura and I
arranged for her to teach me, but...)
(Hoshimura sure is late...)
Heyyy!!

Oh, Hoshimura.
You didn't show up on time, so I was worried.

Sorry, sorry!
I kinda got caught up in some... trouble?
Or something like it, this morning...

What!?
Trouble...? Are you okay, Hoshimura?

...Now, now, let's set that aside
and go study EX-Gear maintenance~!!
Huh! Oh, sure... let's do that......

(She just blatantly changed the subject.
What on earth was that trouble about?)

Now then, let Yui-sensei's
EX-Gear Maintenance Class begin~!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; she styles herself Yui-sensei.

rows.en:
My classes are as strict as Hilda-sensei's,
so brace yourself.

Yeah, yeah. I'm in your hands,
Yui-sensei.
rows.notes: Player, both genders (yoroshiku onegaishimasu, played along).

rows.en:
Mm, very good.
So, what is it you don't get?
It's the engine unit part...

Engine units are easy once you're used to 'em.
Listen up. Here, you do it like this...

Here you go WHAM! like so,
and then it's all WHOOSH! and...

Get this far and the rest is easy.
A tweak here, a twiddle there, a twiddly-
tweak and... ta-da, all done~!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; choi / chochoi / chochoi no choi wordplay as tweak/twiddle.

rows.en: See? Easy, right?
...Huh? Uh, umm...

Sorry, but could you go over it again
from the beginning...

Awww, geez, you're hopeless...
Like I said, here you do it like this......

(When Hoshimura's explanation is mostly
sound effects, I can't understand a thing...)

Hmmm, why don't you get it~?
Like I said, here it goes all WHOOSH and...

(Then tell me what I'm supposed to do
when it goes WHOOSH...)

Wait, huh? My tummy's
sounding the rescue alarm!

(If I keep learning from Hoshimura like this,
I don't think I'll ever understand it...)

You seem hungry too, Hoshimura.
How about we stop studying here
and go grab something to eat?
rows.notes: Male; he says 'Hoshimura too' to her face, rendered as direct address.

rows.en:
Ooh, yes, yes, let's do that!
Lemme see... then let's go eat
steak and pineapple salad~!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Steak and pineapple salad is the famous Macross death-flag meal; translated literally.

rows.en: Ooh, let's go, let's go!
Your treat, of course, right?
rows.notes: x3, Hoshimura, both genders; also frd_yui_008.

rows.en:
After all, I went to the trouble of teaching you
as your sensei. Don't I deserve a little something?
...All right, you win.
Yaaay! What a big spender~!!

Steak awaits us~!
Alriiight, away we gooo~!!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders; rettsura go = 'away we go' (dated slang, fits her register).

rows.en:
(Well, if Hoshimura's this happy about it,
maybe treating her is fine...)

Oh, by the way, Hoshimura,
what was that trouble this morning, anyway?
Oversleeping, of course.
...On second thought, let's scrap the treat.
Nooo~

(Geez... So it wasn't trouble after all.
Hoshimura just overslept...)
(Honestly, Hoshimura's always so full of it.)

(There's some EX-Gear maintenance stuff
I don't get, so I'm sure Yui and I
arranged for her to teach me, but...)
(Yui sure is late...)

Oh, Yui.
You didn't show up on time, so I was worried.
